Name: Asia Scoring
Text: Presence: 3 Domination: 7 Control: 9 +1 VP per controlled Battleground country in Region +1 VP per country controlled that is adjacent to enemy superpower MAY NOT BE HELD!

Name: Europe Scoring
Text: Presence: 3 Domination: 7 Control: Automatic Victory +1 VP per controlled Battleground country in Region +1 VP per country controlled that is adjacent to enemy superpower MAY NOT BE HELD!

Name: Middle East Scoring
Text: Presence: 3 Domination: 5 Control: 7 +1 VP per controlled Battleground country in Region MAY NOT BE HELD!

Name: Duck and Cover
Text: Degrade the DEFCON level by 1. The US receives VP equal to 5 minus the current DEFCON level.

Name: Five Year Plan
Text: The USSR must randomly discard a card. If the card has a US associated Event, the Event occurs immediately. If the card has a USSR associated Event or an Event applicable to both players, then the card must be discarded without triggering the Event.

Name: The China Card
Text: Begins the game with the USSR player. +1 Operations value when all points are used in Asia.  Pass to opponent after play. +1 VP for the player holding this card at the end of Turn 10. Cancels the effect of ‘Formosan Resolution’ (35) if this is played by the US player.

Name: Socialist Governments
Text: Unplayable as an event if ‘The Iron Lady’ (83) is in effect. Remove US influence in Western Europe by a total of 3 Influence points, removing no more than 2 Influence per country.

Name: Fidel*
Text: Remove all US Influence in Cuba. USSR gains sufficient Influence in Cuba for Control.

Name: Vietnam Revolts*
Text: Add 2 USSR Influence in Vietnam. For the remainder of the turn, the Soviet player may add 1 Operations points to any card that uses all points in Southeast Asia.

Name: Blockade*
Text: Unless the US immediately discards a ‘3’ or more value Operations card, eliminate all US Influence from West Germany.

Name: Korean War*
Text: North Korea invades South Korea. Roll a die and subtract 1 for every US controlled country adjacent to South Korea. USSR Victory on modified die roll of 4-6. USSR adds 2 to Military Ops Track. Effect of Victory: USSR gains 2 VP and replaces all US Influence in South Korea with USSR Influence.

Name: Romanian Abdication*
Text: Remove all US Influence in Romania. USSR gains sufficient Influence in Romania for Control.

Name: Arab-Israeli War
Text: Pan-Arab Coalition invades Israel. Roll a die and subtract 1 for US control of Israel and every US-Controlled country adjacent to Israel. USSR Victory on modified die roll of 4-6. USSR adds 2 to Military Ops Track. Effect of Victory: USSR gains 2 VP and replaces all US Influence in Israel with USSR Influence. This Event cannot be used after the ‘Camp David Accords’ (65) Event has been played.

Name: COMECON*
Text: Add 1 USSR Influence in each of four non-US controlled countries of Eastern Europe.

Name: Nasser*
Text: Add 2 USSR Influence in Egypt. Remove half (rounded up) of the US Influence in Egypt.

Name: Warsaw Pact Formed*
Text: Remove all US influence from four countries in Eastern Europe, or add 5 USSR Influence in Eastern Europe, adding no more than 2 Influence per country. This Event allows the ‘NATO’(21) card to be played as an Event.

Name: De Gaulle Leads France*
Text: Remove 2 US Influence in France, add 1 USSR Influence. Cancels the effects of ‘NATO’(21) for France.

Name: Captured Nazi Scientist*
Text: Advance player’s Space Race marker one box.

Name: Truman Doctrine*
Text: Remove all USSR Influence markers in one uncontrolled country in Europe.

Name: Olympic Games
Text: Player sponsors the Olympics. Opponent may participate or boycott. If Opponent participates, each player rolls a die, with sponsor adding 2 to his roll. High roll gains 2 VP.  Reroll ties.  If the opponent boycotts, degrade DEFCON one level and Sponsor may conduct Operations as if they played a 4 Ops card.

Name: NATO*
Text: Play after ‘Marshall Plan’(23) or ‘Warsaw Pact’(16). USSR player may no longer make Coup or Realignment rolls in any US controlled countries in Europe. US controlled countries in Europe may not be attacked by play of the ‘Brush War’ (26) Event.

Name: Independent Reds*
Text: Add sufficient US Influence in either Yugoslavia, Romania, Bulgaria, Hungary, or Czechoslovakia to equal USSR Influence.

Name: Marshall Plan*
Text: Allow play of NATO (21). Add one US Influence in each of seven non-USSR controlled Western European countries.

Name: Indo-Pakistani War
Text: India or Pakistan invades the other (player’s choice). Roll one die and subtract 1 for every opponent-controlled country adjacent to the target of the invasion. Player Victory on modified die roll of 4-6.  Player adds 2 to Military Ops Track. Effects of Victory : Player gains 2 VP and replaces all the opponent’s Influence in the target country with his Influence.

Name: Containment*
Text: All further Operations cards played by US this turn add one to their value (to a maximum of 4).

Name: CIA Created*
Text: USSR reveals hand this turn. Then the US may Conduct Operations as if they played a 1 Op card.

Name: US/Japan Mutual Protection Pact*
Text: US gains sufficient Influence in Japan for Control. USSR may no longer make Coup or Realignment rolls in Japan.

Name: Suez Crisis*
Text: Remove a total of 4 US Influence from France, the United Kingdom and Israel. Remove no more than 2 Influence per country.

Name: East European Unrests
Text: In Early or Mid War: Remove 1 USSR Influence from three countries in Eastern Europe. Late War: Remove 2 USSR Influence from three countries in Eastern Europe.

Name: Decolonization
Text: Add one USSR Influence in each of any four African and/or Southeast Asian countries.

Name: Red Scare/Purge
Text: All further Operations cards played by your opponent this turn are -1 to their value (to a minimum value of 1 Operations point).

Name: UN Intervention
Text: Play this card simultaneously with a card containing your opponent’s associated Event. The Event is canceled, but you may use the Operations value of the opponent’s card to conduct Operations. The cancelled event card returns to the discard pile.  May not be played during the Headline Phase.

Name: De-Stalinization*
Text: USSR may relocate up to 4 Influence points to non-US controlled countries. No more than 2 Influence may be placed in the same country.

Name: Nuclear Test Ban
Text: Player earns VPs equal to current DEFCON level minus 2, then improve DEFCON two levels.

Name: Formosan Resolution*
Text: Taiwan shall be treated as a Battleground country for scoring purposes, if the US controls Taiwan when the Asia Scoring Card is played or during Final Scoring at the end of Turn 10.  Taiwan is not a Battleground country for any other game purpose.  This card is discarded after the US play of ‘The China Card’ (6).

Name: Defectors
Text: Play in Headline Phase to cancel USSR Headline Event, including a Scoring Card. Canceled card returns to discard pile. If Defectors played by the USSR during Soviet action round, US gains 1 VP (unless played on the Space Race).

Name: The Cambridge Five
Text: The US player exposes all scoring cards in their hand. The USSR player may add 1 USSR Influence to any single Region named on one of these scoring cards (USSR choice). Cannot be played as an Event in Late War.

Name: Special Relationship
Text: If UK is US controlled but NATO is not in effect, US adds 1 influence to any country adjacent to the UK.  If UK is US controlled and ‘NATO’ (21)  is in effect, US adds 2 US Influence to any Western European country and gains 2 VPs.

Name: NORAD*
Text: If the US controls Canada, the US may add 1 Influence to any country already containing US Influence at the conclusion of any Action Round in which the DEFCON level moved to the ‘2’ box. This Event is canceled by ‘Quagmire’ (42).

Name: Bagdad Pact*
Text: Remove 1 Soviet influence from Iraq and Turkey and add 1 US influence in Pakistan or Iran.
Special Note: This is a promotional card that was given by Bard Centrum Gier as part of the release of Polish Deluxe version of the game published in 2013.  The card was later translated and included in 2015 Italian release from Asterion.

Name: Kremlin Flu
Text: US takes Operations as if this card were played as Operations.  USSR must play a scoring card on its next Action Round if it holds one; if no scoring card is in the USSR hand, the USSR forfeits its next Action Round.
Special Note: This is a promotional card that was given by GMT as a reward to backers of their 2014 Kickstarter campaign.

Name: First Lightning*
Text: Play at the same time you play a card with US-Affiliated Event for its Operations. Ignore the event text and place the card in the discard pile. Reduce DEFCON by 1 if this card is played for Operations or its Event.
Special Note: This is a promotional card that was given by GMT as a reward to backers of their 2014 Kickstarter campaign.

Name: Who lost China
Text: If the USSR holds the China Card, reset US Military Operations to zero. If playing with the Chinese Civil War variant, this card cannot be played if Chinese Civil War is still in effect.
Special Note: This is a promotional card that was given by GMT as a reward to backers of their 2014 Kickstarter campaign.

Name: Brush War
Text: Attack any country with a stability of 1 or 2. Roll a die and subtract 1 for every adjacent enemy controlled country. Success on 3-6. Player adds 3 to its Military Operations Track. Effects of Victory: Player gains 1 VP and replaces all opponent’s Influence with his Influence.

Name: Central America Scoring
Text: Presence: 1 Domination: 3 Control: 5 +1 VP per controlled Battleground country in Region +1 VP per country controlled that is adjacent to enemy superpower MAY NOT BE HELD!

Name: South East Asia Scoring*
Text: VP each for Control of: Burma, Cambodia/Laos, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia and the Philippines. 2 VPs for Control of Thailand. MAY NOT BE HELD!

Name: Arms Race
Text: Compare each player’s status on the Military Operations Tracks. If Phasing Player has more Military Operation points, he scores 1 VP. If Phasing Player has more Military Operation points and has met the Required Military Operations amount, he scores 3 VP instead.

Name: Cuban Missile Crisis*
Text: Set DEFCON to level 2. Any further Coup attempts by your opponent this turn, anywhere on the board, will result in Global Thermonuclear War. Your opponent will lose the game. This event may be canceled at any time if the USSR player removes two Influence from Cuba or the US removes 2 Influence from West Germany or Turkey.

Name: Nuclear Subs*
Text: US Coup Attempts in Battleground countries do not affect the DEFCON track for the remainder of the turn (does not affect ‘Cuban Missile Crisis’ (40)).

Name: Quagmire*
Text: On next action round, US player must discard an Operations card worth 2 or more and roll 1-4 to cancel this Event. Repeat each US player action round until successful or no appropriate cards remain. If out of appropriate cards, the US player may only play scoring cards until the next turn. This Event cancels the effect of ‘NORAD’ (106).

Name: SALT Negotiations*
Text: Improve the DEFCON two levels. Further Coup attempts incur -1 die roll modifier for both players for the remainder of the turn. Player may sort through the discard pile and reclaim one non-scoring card, after revealing it to their opponent.

Name: Bear Trap*
Text: On next action round, USSR player must discard an Operations card worth 2 or more and roll 1-4 to cancel this Event. Repeat each USSR player action round until successful or no appropriate cards remain. If out of appropriate cards, the USSR player may only play scoring cards until the next turn.

Name: Summit
Text: Both players roll a die. Each adds 1 for each Region they Dominate or Control. High roller gains 2 VPs and may move DEFCON marker one level in either direction. Do not reroll ties.

Name: How I Learned to Stop Worrying*
Text: Set the DEFCON at any level you want (1-5). This event counts as 5 Military Operations for the purpose of required Military Operations.

Name: Junta
Text: Place 2 Influence in any one Central or South American country. Then you may make a free Coup attempt or Realignment roll in one of these regions (using this card’s Operations Value).

Name: Kitchen Debates*
Text: If the US controls more Battleground countries than the USSR, poke opponent in chest and gain 2 VP!

Name: Missile Envy
Text: Exchange this card for your opponent’s highest value Operations card. If two or more cards are tied, opponent chooses. If the exchanged card contains your event, or applicable to both players, it occurs immediately. If it contains opponent’s event, use Operations value without triggering the event.  Opponent must use this card for Operations during his next action round.

Name: We Will Bury You*
Text: Unless ‘UN Intervention’ (32) is played as an Event on the US player’s next action round, USSR gains 3 VP prior to any US VP award. Degrade DEFCON one level.

Name: Brezhnev Doctrine*
Text: All further Operations cards played by the USSR this turn increase their Ops value by one (to a maximum of 4).

Name: Portuguese Empire Crumbles*
Text: Add 2 USSR Influence in both the SE African States and Angola.

Name: South African Unrest
Text: USSR either adds 2 Influence in South Africa or adds 1 Influence to South Africa and 2 Influence in any countries adjacent to South Africa.

Name: Allende*
Text: USSR receives 2 Influence in Chile.

Name: Willy Brant*
Text: USSR gains 1 VP. USSR receives 1 Influence in West Germany. Cancels ‘NATO’ (21) for West Germany. This event unplayable and/or canceled by ‘Tear Down this Wall’ (96).

Name: Muslim Revolution
Text: Remove all US Influence in two of the following countries: Sudan, Iran, Iraq, Egypt, Libya, Saudi Arabia, Syria, Jordan. This Event cannot be used after the ‘AWACS Sale to Saudis’ (110) Event has been played.

Name: ABM Treaty
Text: Improve DEFCON one level. Then player may Conduct Operations as if they played a 4 Ops card.

Name: Cultural Revolution*
Text: If the US has the ‘The China Card’ (6), claim it face up and available to play.  If the USSR already has it, USSR gains 1 VP.

Name: Flower Power*
Text: USSR gains 2 VP for every subsequently US played “War card” (played as an event or Operations) unless played on the space race. War Cards: ‘Arab-Israeli War’ (13), ‘Korean War’ (11), ‘Brush War’ (36), ‘Indo- Pakistani War’ (24), ‘Iran-Iraq War’ (102). This Event is prevented / canceled by the ‘An Evil Empire’ (97) Event.

Name: U2 Incident*
Text: USSR gains 1 VP. If the ‘UN Intervention’ (32) Event is played later this turn, either by the US or the USSR, then gain an additional 1 VP.

Name: OPEC
Text: USSR gains 1 VP for each of the following countries he controls: Egypt, Iran, Libya, Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Gulf States, Venezuela. Unplayable as an event if ‘North Sea Oil’ (86) is in effect.

Name: Lone Gunman*
Text: US player reveals his hand.  Then the USSR may Conduct Operations as if they played a 1 Op card.

Name: Colonial Rearguards
Text: Add 1 US Influence in each of four different African and/or Southeast Asian countries.

Name: Panama Canal Returned*
Text: Add 1 US Influence in Panama, Costa Rica and Venezuela.

Name: Camp David Accords*
Text: US gains 1 VP. US receives 1 Influence in Israel, Jordan and Egypt. ‘Arab-Israeli War’ (13) event no longer playable.

Name: Puppet Governments*
Text: US may add 1 Influence in three countries that currently contain no Influence from either power.

Name: Grain Sales to Soviets
Text: Randomly choose one card from the USSR hand. Play it or return it.  If Soviet player has no cards, or returned, use this card to conduct Operations normally.

Name: John Paul II Elected Pope*
Text: Remove 2 USSR Influence in Poland and then add 1 US Influence in Poland. Allows play of ‘Solidarity’ (101).

Name: Latin American Death Squads
Text: All of the player’s Coup Attempts in Central and South America are +1 for the remainder of the turn, while all opponent’s Coup attempts are -1 for the remainder of the turn.

Name: OAS Founded*
Text: Add 2 US Influence in Central America and/or South America.

Name: Nixon Plays the China Card*
Text: If the US has the ‘The China Card’ (6), gain 2 VP.  Otherwise, US player receives ‘The China Card’ (6)now, face down and unavailable for immediate play.

Name: Sadat Expels Soviets*
Text: Remove all USSR Influence in Egypt and add one US Influence.

Name: Shuttle Diplomacy
Text: Play in front of US player.  During the next scoring of the Middle East or Asia (whichever comes first), subtract one Battleground country from USSR total, then put this card in the discard pile.  Does not count for Final Scoring at the end of turn 10.

Name: The Voice of America
Text: Remove 4 USSR Influence from non-European countries.  No more than 2 may be removed from any one country.

Name: Liberation Theology
Text: Add 3 USSR Influence in Central America, no more than 2 per country.

Name: Ussuri River Skirmish*
Text: If the USSR has ‘The China Card’ (6), claim it face up and available to play.  If the US already has ‘The China Card’ (6), add 4 US Influence in Asia, no more than 2 per country.

Name: “Ask Not What Your Country Can Do For You…”*
Text: US player may discard up to entire hand (including scoring cards) and draw replacements from the deck. The number of cards to be discarded must be decided before drawing any replacement.

Name: Alliance for Progress*
Text: US gains 1 VP for each US controlled Battleground country in Central and South America.

Name: Africa Scoring
Text: Presence: 1 Domination: 4 Control: 6 +1 VP per controlled Battleground country in Region MAY NOT BE HELD!

Name: “One Small Step…”
Text: If you are behind on the Space Race Track, play this card to move your marker two boxes forward on the Space Race Track, the player uses this Event to move their marker 2 spaces forward on the Space Race Track, gaining the VP value of the second box only.

Name: South America Scoring
Text: Presence: 2 Domination: 5 Control: 6 +1 VP per controlled Battleground country in Region MAY NOT BE HELD!

Name: Che
Text: USSR may immediately make a Coup Attempt using this card’s Operations value against a non-Battleground country in Central America, South America or Africa. If the Coup removes any US Influence, USSR may make a second Coup Attempt, against a different target under the same restrictions.

Name: Our Man in Tehran*
Text: If the US controls at least one Middle East country, the US player draws the top 5 cards from the draw pile. They may reveal and then discard any or all of the drawn cards, after revealing the discarded card(s) to the USSR player, without triggering the Event. Any remaining drawn cards are returned to the draw deck, and it is reshuffled.

Name: Years of Lead*
Text: If there is at least one nation in Western Europe that USSR does not Controlled, remove all USSR Influence from that country except 1 (if more countries are not controlled by USSR, the US player choose which country).
Special Note: This is a promotional card that was given by Asterion in 2011 as part of the release of Italian Deluxe version of the game.  The card is not known to exist in any other language. ‘NATO Referendum’ and ‘Year of Lead’ cards both have the same number

Name: Non-Aligned Movement
Text: Select India or a country in Africa, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, or South America with at least 2 US and USSR Influence. Remove all Influence from that country, then take the next four cards from the top draw pile and put them in the discard pile (reshuffling if necessary).
Special Note: This is a promotional card that was given by GMT as a reward to backers of their 2014 Kickstarter campaign.

Name: Mobutu Sese Seko*
Text: Zaire’s stability number permanently becomes 3.  Add 2 US Influence in Zaire.
Special Note: This is a promotional card that was given by GMT as a reward to backers of their 2014 Kickstarter campaign.

Name: Berlin Wall*
Text: Add 2 Influence in East Germany and, if you are behind or tied with the US in the Space Race, advance your Space Race marker by one box.
Special Note: This is a promotional card that was given by GMT as a reward to backers of their 2014 Kickstarter campaign.

Name: “Don’t Wait for the Translation”*
Text: If the US is behind in Military Operations, the US scores 2 VP.
Special Note: This is a promotional card that was given by GMT as a reward to backers of their 2014 Kickstarter campaign.

Name: Iranian Hostage Crisis*
Text: Remove all US Influence in Iran.  Add 2 USSR Influence in Iran. Doubles the effect of ‘Terrorism’ (92) card against US.

Name: The Iron Lady*
Text: US gains 1 VP. Add 1 USSR Influence to Argentina. Remove all USSR Influence from UK. ‘Socialist Governments’ (7) event no longer playable.

Name: Reagan Bombs Libya*
Text: US gains 1 VP for every 2 USSR Influence in Libya.

Name: Star Wars*
Text: If the US is ahead on the Space Race Track, play this card to search through the discard pile for a non-scoring card of your choice. Event occurs immediately.

Name: North Sea Oil*
Text: ‘OPEC’ (61) event no longer playable. US may play 8 cards this turn.

Name: The Reformer*
Text: Add 4 USSR Influence in Europe (no more than 2 per country).  If USSR is ahead of US in VP, then 6 Influence may be added instead. USSR may no longer conduct Coup attempts in Europe. Improves effect of ‘Glasnost’(90) event.

Name: Marine Barracks Bombing*
Text: Remove all US Influence in Lebanon plus remove 2 additional US Influence from anywhere in the Middle East.

Name: Soviets Shoot Down KAL-007*
Text: Degrade DEFCON one level. US gains 2 VP. If South Korea is US controlled, then the US may place Influence or attempt Realignments as if they played a 4 Ops card.

Name: Glasnost*
Text: USSR gains 2 VP. Improve DEFCON one level. If ‘The Reformer’ (87) is in effect, then the USSR may place Influence or attempt Realignments as if they played a 4 Ops card.

Name: Ortega Elected in Nicaragua*
Text: Remove all US Influence from Nicaragua. Then USSR may make one free Coup attempt (with this card’s Operations value) in a country adjacent to Nicaragua.

Name: Terrorism
Text: Opponent must randomly discard one card.   If played by the USSR and ‘Iranian Hostage Crisis’ (82) is in effect, the US player must randomly discard two cards. Events on discards do not occur.

Name: Iran-Contra Scandal*
Text: All US Realignment rolls have a -1 die roll modifier for the remainder of the turn.

Name: Chernobyl*
Text: The US player may designate one Region.  For the remainder of the turn the USSR may not add additional Influence to that region by the play of Operation Points via placing Influence.

Name: Latin America Debt Crisis
Text: Unless the US play immediately discards a ‘3’ or greater Operations card, double the USSR Influence in two countries in South America.

Name: Tear Down this Wall*
Text: Cancels/ prevents ‘Willy Brandt’(55). Add 3 US Influence in East Germany. Then US may make free Coup attempt or Realignment rolls in Europe using this card’s Ops value.

Name: An Evil Empire*
Text: Cancel/Prevents ‘Flower Power’ (59). US gains 1 VP.

Name: Aldrich Ames Remix*
Text: US player exposes his hand to USSR player for the remainder of turn.  USSR then chooses one card from US hand; this card is discarded. Notes: This card was included in the Deluxe Editions in replacement of the original ‘Aldrich Ames’ card.

Name: Pershing II Deployed*
Text: USSR gains 1 VP. Remove 1 US Influence from up to three countries in Western Europe.

Name: Wargames*
Text: If DEFCON status 2, you may immediately end the game (without Final Scoring Phase) after giving opponent 6 VPs. How about a nice game of chess?

Name: Solidarity*
Text: Playable as an event only if ‘John Paul II Elected Pope’ (68) is in effect. Add 3 US Influence in Poland.

Name: Iran-Iraq War*
Text: Iran or Iraq invades the other (player’s choice). Roll one die and subtract 1 for every opponent-controlled country adjacent to target of invasion. Player Victory on modified die roll of 4-6.  Play adds 2 to Military Ops Track. Effect of Victory: Player gains 2 VP and replaces all opponent’s Influence in target country with his own

Name: Samantha and Yuri*
Text: USSR receives 1 VP for each US Coup Attempt made for the remainder of the current Turn.

Name: AWACS Sale to Saudi*
Text: US receives 2 Influence in Saudi Arabia. ‘Muslim Revolution’ (56) may no longer be played as an Event.

Name: NATO Referendum**
Text: Playable as an even only if ‘NATO’ (21) is in effect. Each player rolls a die. The active player adds +1 and the player with more influence in Spain/Portugal also adds +1.  In case of a tie, roll again.  The winner gains 1 VP and 1 influence in Spain/Portugal. Cancels the effects of ‘NATO’ (21) for Spain/Portugal if USSR player win.
Special Note: This is a promotional card that was given by Devir in 2012 as part of the release of Spanish Deluxe version of the game.  The card is not known to exist in any other language or versions.

Name: Martial Law*
Text: Remove 1 US influence from Poland. Add 1 USSR influence in one country adjacent to Poland. ‘Solidarity’ (101) cannot be played as event this turn.
Special Note: This is a promotional card that was included in Bard Centrum Gier Polish third edition of the game released in 2013.  The card was later translated and included in 2015 Italian release from Asterion.

Name: Stanislav Petrov*
Text: Play only if DEFCON is 2. Set DEFCON to 4 or 5.
Special Note: This is a promotional card that was given by GMT as a reward to backers of their 2014 Kickstarter campaign.
